# Conscious
Private mood journal. Runs entirely in your browser (localStorage); nothing is sent anywhere.

Does: save a line, keyword-based mood score (small word list, not AI), last 7 entries, 3-vs-3 trend, JSON export, JSON import.
Does not: use machine learning, sync across devices, or back up automatically. Clearing browser data erases entries, so export regularly.
